annotations.title: V12 critical: Signature replay across chains
annotations.message:
The permit digest omits the chain id. A reviewer confirmed this despite the automatic invalidation.

Fingerprint c9ecb9cf8cf93ea3 · https://v12.sh/runs/42/104
annotations.raw_details:
Impact: Signatures can be replayed on forks.

Root cause: EIP-712 domain separator without chainId.

annotations.title: V12 critical: Reentrancy in withdraw() lets a caller drain the vault
annotations.message:
`withdraw()` sends ETH with `call` before updating `balances[msg.sender]`, so a malicious receiver can re-enter and withdraw repeatedly.

Fingerprint 03fd1caea09bb909 · https://v12.sh/runs/42/101
annotations.raw_details:
Impact: Complete loss of vault funds.

Root cause: State update happens after the external call (checks-effects-interactions violated).

annotations.title: V12 critical: Integer overflow in reward accounting
annotations.message:
Auto-invalidated by V12's PoC run: Solidity 0.8 checked arithmetic prevents this.

Fingerprint d8c8bf0ce16a1089 · https://v12.sh/runs/42/103

Root cause: Analysis assumed unchecked arithmetic.

annotations.title: V12 critical: Unchecked external call return value | funds stuck in escrow
annotations.message:

annotations.title: V12 medium: Price manipulation through flash-loaned liquidity
annotations.message:
# Not a heading

The spot price is read from the pool reserves in the same transaction.

- reserves can be moved with a flash loan
- the vault mints against the manipulated price

See <https://example.com/flash> and the `getPrice()` helper. Ends with an HTML comment terminator: -->

annotations.raw_details:

Root cause: Spot price used as oracle.
